description: This Java class 'ModifyResources' is part of a policy command module, specifically designed to modify 'Resources' entries associated with a 'PolicyEntry' in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes methods for creating instances from parameters or JSON, and methods for retrieving details like policy ID, label, and resources.

classes.name: ModifyResources
classes.description: Immutable command class that modifies Resources within a PolicyEntry, including creation from parameters or JSON, and retrieving modification details.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new instance of ModifyResources with specified policyId, label, resources, and headers. Deprecated version accepts policyId as String.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a ModifyResources instance from a JSON string or JsonObject.

methods.name: getLabel
methods.description: Returns the label associated with the PolicyEntry to modify.

methods.name: getResources
methods.description: Returns the Resources object that will be used to modify the PolicyEntry.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Returns the PolicyId of the Policy to which the modification applies.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the Resources as a JsonValue, formatted for a specific schema version.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON Pointer path to the resources of the PolicyEntry.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Creates a new ModifyResources instance with specified DittoHeaders.
